# UPSTREAM004-G — Protos optimizing Native re-enablement checkpoint (2026-11-17)

**Supersedes UPSTREAM004-F only for the current Protos product capability statement.** The 2026-11-13 failures and Oracle's reply remain valid historical evidence; do not edit the F snapshot.

## Changed evidence since F

- Oracle's [graal#14579](https://github.com/oracle/graal/issues/14579) was closed after a **configuration explanation**: generated Bytecode DSL root classes initialized at image run time may leave their execution paths opaque to Native runtime compilation. This was **not** an upstream compiler fix demonstrated by F.
- In F, experimental optimizing Native builds had failed on `BigInteger.valueOf(long)` blocklist reachability or image-heap initialization, so no native Tier-2 probe had run.
- On 2026-11-17, the maintainer supplied a **successful** Protos Native CLI build and real Tier-2 trace on the GraalVM/Truffle **25.5.5.0.3** plane, with zero observed `FrameWithoutBoxing` failures. A later local `make test-native` run passed the positive JIT regression **and** the separate Native TLS JUnit image and its 38 selected tests.
- The published product commit is [`guillermomolina/protos@50a7d3b6924c8a2a87e0488f909d8fa98316dc66`](https://github.com/guillermomolina/protos/commit/50a7d3b6924c8a2a87e0488f909d8fa98316dc66) (`0.4.155-SNAPSHOT`). The complete local log used a `0.4.154-SNAPSHOT` image built before that version bump, without a checkout SHA; the maintainer separately states all tests pass locally after publication. Do not present the supplied run as an immutable post-commit test transcript.

## Direct acceptance

```text
NATIVE_GUEST_JIT=PASS
BYTECODE_ROOT_TIER2_COMPILATIONS=2
BUILTIN_CALL_ROOT_TIER2_COMPILATIONS=2
OPT_DONE=4
OPT_FAILED=0
FRAME_WITHOUT_BOXING_FAILURES=0
COMPILATION_FAILURES=0
NATIVE_FALLBACK_RUNTIME_MARKERS=0
NATIVE_REGRESSION_SUITE=PASS
NATIVE_TLS_PEER_INTEGRATION=PASS
NATIVE_TLS_TRUST_PROVENANCE=PASS
NATIVE_TLS_JUNIT_TESTS=38/38
```

The maintained positive probe runs with immediate synchronous optimization and checks two *current* root types, `ProtosBytecodeRootNodeGen` and `ProtosBuiltinCallRootNode`. They are not the two historic generated Bytecode DSL roots named in BUG013's original workload.

The separate Native JUnit image needs `--initialize-at-run-time=com.guillermomolina.protos.execution.ProtosTestExecutionSupport` in **its own Maven profile**, to avoid image-heap references to a builder-created shared Polyglot context and worker thread. This is a test-image scope correction; the CLI production initialization policy stays unchanged.

## Disposition and limits

```text
ORACLE_GRAAL_14579=UPSTREAM_CLOSED_WITH_CONFIGURATION_EXPLANATION
PROTOS_OPTIMIZING_NATIVE_BUILD=PASS_ON_REPORTED_LOCAL_RUN
PROTOS_NATIVE_GUEST_TIER2=PASS_ON_REPORTED_LOCAL_RUN
PROTOS_NATIVE_FRAMEWITHOUTBOXING_FAILURES=0_IN_REPORTED_PROBE
PROTOS_NATIVE_INTERPRETER_ONLY_ADMISSION=SUPERSEDED_BY_I115
PROTOS_NATIVE_TLS_JUNIT=PASS_38_OF_38
PRODUCT_COMMIT=50a7d3b6924c8a2a87e0488f909d8fa98316dc66
PRODUCT_VERSION=0.4.155-SNAPSHOT
EXACT_COMMIT_TEST_TRANSCRIPT=NOT_PROVIDED
UPSTREAM_COMPILER_PATCH_VERIFIED=NO
RELEASE_OR_ASSET_PUBLICATION=NO
```

This checkpoint resolves the **previously unverified Protos native optimization capability on the tested workloads**, not every possible upstream bailout and not an independent GraalVM fix. Do not reopen historical closed issues automatically or infer release approval. UPSTREAM004's live tracking disposition remains with [#753](https://github.com/guillermomolina/protos/issues/753); no new owner decision to stop tracking is recorded here.

**Detailed acceptance:** [I115 Native Tier-2 JIT and TLS JUnit record](../I115/I115_NATIVE_GUEST_TIER2_AND_NATIVE_TLS_JUNIT_ACCEPTANCE_2026_11_17.md). **Earlier checkpoint:** [UPSTREAM004-F](UPSTREAM004_F_ORACLE_RESPONSE_PROTOS_NATIVE_OPTIMIZER_CHECKPOINT_2026_11_13.md).
